name: git_blame_hot
description: Git blame of a file or line range: lines per author, last change, hot lines rewritten by many commits

path.description: tracked file to blame (project-relative or absolute)

start.description: first line of the range, 1-based (default: whole file)

end.description: last line of the range, inclusive (default: end of file)

n.description: recent commits of the file used as context for hot lines (default 50)

data.file: str (path relative to the repository root)
data.commits: int (distinct commits owning lines in the range)
data.recent_commits: int (commits of the file seen, <= n)
